periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation tilted approximately 45 degrees downward toward the nasal bridge.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with the vertical axis significantly exceeding the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering extending well below the medial ocular line.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped posterior boundary across the scapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High; the band occupies approximately 40% of the visible dorsal-ventral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation approximately equal to the width of the cranial vault between the medial ear bases.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex, semicircular curvature along the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive distribution of green vegetative debris (moss or grass) adhering to the fur across the face, ears, and dorsal band.
